typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsNonSTPTradeVolumeStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		DEALSRCE as string,
		LSTMNTDATE as timestamp,
		NON_STP_COUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LoadNonSTPrecords
LoadNonSTPrecords derive(LoadDate = toString(currentTimestamp())) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LoadDate as string,
		DEALSRCE as string,
		NONSTP_COUNT as string,
		LSTMNTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		DEALSRCE,
		NONSTP_COUNT = NON_STP_COUNT,
		LSTMNTDATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsNonSTPTradeVolumeStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsNonSTPTradeVolumeStaging
